acceptance_limits: Candidate checkout defaults to strict. Release runs explicitly set reuse._release_state.mode before runpy as diagnostic only.
Private-state release measurements do not establish packaged release admission, EXE behaviour or strict scientific acceptance.
I02 is not an allowed packaged entry point; its release result is a diagnostic cost comparison only.
Single-pass timings are observations without confidence intervals. No reruns were used to improve timings.
I02 release diagnostic is slower: the regression is retained. No causal benchmark claim is made.

candidate_request_derivation.encoding: SHA-256 of json.dumps(payload, sort_keys=True, separators=(comma,colon), ensure_ascii=True, allow_nan=False).encode(ascii)

commands.bootstrap_import_timing: Actual elapsed time around subprocess execution is primary; driver wall_s is not used for comparisons.
commands.per_configuration: PYTHON -B bootstrap.py --tree TREE --mode MODE --driver WORKLOAD [-- DRIVER_ARGS]

explanations.evidence: tectonics/tools/new_world_layout.py:55 returns SHA-256 of exact adapter source bytes. All captured hashes equal the frozen source manifest.
tectonics/tools/new_world_motion.py:64 calls new_world_arcs.source_hash; tectonics/tools/new_world_arcs.py:35 hashes exact adapter source bytes.
tectonics/tools/new_world_evolution.py:54 hashes imported adapter file bytes; all three captured values equal the frozen source manifest.
tectonics/tools/new_world_project.py:281 adds execution_mode=release only for release mode; strict omits this provenance field.

prototype_adaptations: Original workload/digest exclusions unchanged. Unavailable prototype verification counters replaced by null, not fabricated counts.
Mode telemetry queries actual production execution_mode, or strict for baseline without that function.
Regional job source-world child uses the same explicit diagnostic bootstrap and asserts its observed mode equals the parent.
Both configurations use matched bootstrap import placement; comparison uses external process seconds.

raw_records.location: External coordinator-held matched-pass-1 records, not part of the repository.

scope: Seven bounded trusted-local workloads. One fresh process per driver/configuration, plus the original regional_job world child. No broad suites, repeats, full simulation or packaged EXE.
supplemental_separated_digest_note: Supplemental byte comparisons replace only the exact verified adapter-source/derived-request identities and remove only the two execution_mode provenance fields listed above. Original digests and every differing value remain retained; no unexplained differences are excluded.
